title: Request squares from a generator
description: You can compare a completed list with values requested from an ongoing sequence.

steps.description: The eager function appends squares to a list before returning. squares_lazy yields one square and increments i after resuming.
The demonstration displays a five-element list and then requests seven generator values. The loop breaks after displaying 36.

steps.question: Does gen2 continue from the earlier generator's last value?
steps.answer: No. It is a fresh generator, so its first three values are 0, 1, and 4.

steps.description: The explicit next calls show those three values. first_n then collects ten requested values from another fresh generator.
countdown displays 3, 2, 1, and 0. A later next call on that exhausted generator reaches the StopIteration handler.
